title: Desk Guidance: Remote-Disconnect Meter Relief in a Security Deposits Recalculation
content:
In the recalculation of a held Security Deposits deposit, an account fitted with a remote-disconnect meter earns a remote-meter relief.

## Guidance

The remote-meter relief is the clean remote relief of **0.05** when this account has a remote-disconnect meter and no returned payment in the last twelve whole months, the returned remote relief of **0.02** when it has a remote-disconnect meter and a returned payment in that period, and nothing otherwise. The remote-meter relief is taken off the recalculation multiple. The recalculation multiple is never below **1.0**; that floor is applied once, to the multiple as finally reckoned.

The meter type and the returned payments are read from this account's Electric Service by Rate Schedule record; a remote-disconnect meter is the AMI meter type with remote disconnect.

## Input, judgement, output

| Remote-disconnect meter on this account | Returned payments, last twelve whole months | Relief |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none | 0.05 |
| yes | one or more | 0.02 |
| no | any | nothing |
